notes: Twelve-scenario live pilot (one pilot-run invocation). PROPOSED, NOT AUTHORIZED: max_spend_usd 1.00 is a proposed cap; set live_enabled to true only after it is authorized. Sized from live dev01/dev02 (Haiku 5.5, 2026-10-12): largest request 2,675 bytes, largest output 103 tokens, 1 tool call and 2 requests per agent, no thinking. The longest scripted pilot plan (sc04/sc09 processor: 4 tool calls, 5 requests, 4,164 bytes scripted) projects to about 5.8 KB live. Limits: 6 tool calls and 7 requests per agent (6 calls plus a final reply), 12,000 context bytes (about 2x that projection), 2,048 output tokens (about 20x the observed maximum, room for some adaptive thinking), 252 total requests (12 x 3 x 7). Pessimistic maximum $0.963648 for 12 episodes. Temperature and seed are null (Haiku 5.5 rejects non-default sampling values); prompt caching is disabled by the backend.
